title: The Moisture a Drying Pass Is Taken to Have Started From
content:
The moisture the grain started the pass at is read from the records rather than assumed. This rule governs conditioning on Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements, and the intake reading it falls back on comes from the member's own scale ticket under Grain Marketing Contracts, on the load applied into storage.

## The rule as posted

Where a conditioning charge already stands on the storage account showing the moisture the grain was left at, the pass starts from that moisture, because the water taken out earlier is not paid for twice.

Where no conditioning charge stands on the account and the scale ticket the grain came in on shows no moisture reading, the pass starts from the programme's target moisture plus the programme's minimum points.

And otherwise the pass starts from the moisture the scale read in when the grain was taken into store.

## The two programme figures the middle line adds together

| Programme | Target moisture (percent) | Minimum points | Their sum (percent) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Open Storage Account | 15.0 | 0.5 | 15.5 |
| Grain Bank Deposit Account | 15.0 | 0.5 | 15.5 |
| Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage | 14.5 | 0.5 | 15.0 |
| Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement | 14.5 | 0.5 | 15.0 |
| Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement | 14.0 | 0.5 | 14.5 |
| Identity Preserved Segregated Storage | 13.5 | 0.5 | 14.0 |

## Where each line bites

| A conditioning charge stands on the storage account showing the moisture the grain was left at | The scale ticket shows a moisture reading | The pass starts from |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | either way | the moisture that charge left the grain at |
| no | no | the programme's target moisture plus the programme's minimum points |
| no | yes | the moisture the scale read in when the grain was taken into store |

## Where the intake reading is found

The intake reading is the moisture recorded against the member's own delivery into storage in the grain ledger kept under Grain Marketing Contracts, taken from the most recent such delivery. Where that ledger carries no moisture against the load, there is no intake reading to start from, and the middle line of the clause governs.

## Worked readings, on hypothetical figures

**A Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement whose account already carries a conditioning charge showing the grain left at 16.1 percent.** The pass starts from 16.1 percent, whatever the scale ticket said on the way in.

**An Identity Preserved Segregated Storage whose account carries no conditioning charge, and whose scale ticket shows no moisture at all.** The pass starts from that programme's target of 13.5 percent plus its minimum points of 0.5, which is 14.0 percent.

**An Open Storage Account whose account carries no conditioning charge, with a scale ticket showing 18.6 percent on the way in.** The pass starts from 18.6 percent.
